name: Ageing Potion
d: A few drops add years to the drinker. Fred and George took some to get past the line around the Goblet of Fire, and ended up with long white beards.

name: Amortentia
d: The most powerful infatuation potion in the world, with a mother-of-pearl sheen and steam rising in spirals. It smells different to everyone, of whatever attracts them.

name: Baruffio's Brain Elixir
d: Eddie Carmichael tried to sell a pint of this to anxious fifth-years before their O.W.L.s, claiming it got him nine Outstandings.

name: Befuddlement Draught
d: Makes the drinker belligerent and reckless. Fifth-years wrote an essay on it alongside another potion that muddles the mind.

name: Blood-Replenishing Potion
d: Healers at St Mungo's had to give Mr Weasley a dose every hour, because the snake's venom kept his wounds from closing.

name: Bruise removal paste
d: A thick yellow ointment Fred and George made after a punching telescope gave Hermione a black eye that wouldn't fade.

name: Confusing Concoction
d: Leaves the drinker muddled and unable to think straight. Fifth-years wrote about it alongside a potion that makes you belligerent and reckless.

name: Cure for Boils
d: The first potion Snape set his first-years. Neville melted Seamus's cauldron making it and broke out in angry red spots.

name: Deflating Draught
d: Snape handed this out in the dungeon after a firework in Goyle's cauldron left half the class with ballooning noses and hands.

name: Doxycide
d: A black spray the Weasleys used on the curtains at Grimmauld Place to stun the biting fairy-like pests nesting inside.

name: Draught of Living Death
d: A sleeping potion so powerful the drinker seems lifeless. It uses powdered root of asphodel and an infusion of wormwood, and Harry won Felix Felicis by brewing it.

name: Draught of Peace
d: Calms anxiety and soothes agitation. Snape set it for his O.W.L. class; add too much hellebore and the drinker falls into a heavy, sometimes permanent, sleep.

name: Dreamless Sleep Potion
d: Madam Pomfrey gave Harry a dose after the third task so he could rest without nightmares or visions.

name: Drink of Despair
d: The emerald potion in the basin on the island in the cave. Dumbledore drank every drop while begging Harry to stop.

name: Elixir of Life
d: Made with the Philosopher's Stone; whoever keeps drinking it never dies. Nicolas Flamel lived over six hundred years on it.

name: Elixir to Induce Euphoria
d: Fills the drinker with an irrational happiness. Harry added a sprig of peppermint to his to stop the side effects, and Slughorn loved it.

name: Felix Felicis
d: A tiny bottle of what looks like molten gold. For a few hours, everything the drinker tries goes their way. Harry used it to get a memory from Slughorn.

name: Fire Protection Potion
d: In the last chamber before the Stone, Snape's logic puzzle hid a tiny bottle that let Harry walk safely through black flames.

name: Forgetfulness Potion
d: First-years brewed this in their end-of-year Potions exam. It makes the drinker lose their memories.

name: Love Potion
d: Makes the drinker infatuated with whoever gave it to them. Romilda Vane slipped one into Chocolate Cauldrons meant for Harry.

name: Love Potion Antidote
d: Cures someone of an artificial infatuation. Slughorn gave Ron one on his birthday.

name: Mandrake Restorative Draught
d: Brewed from roots grown in Professor Sprout's greenhouses, it woke the students who had been Petrified by the basilisk.

name: Mrs Scower's All-Purpose Magical Mess Remover
d: A cleaning product Filch reached for when a message about the Chamber of Secrets was painted on his wall.

name: Murtlap Essence
d: A yellow solution of strained, pickled tentacles. Hermione gave it to Harry to soothe the cuts Umbridge's quill left on his hand.

name: Pepperup Potion
d: Madam Pomfrey's cold remedy. It works at once but leaves steam pouring out of the drinker's ears for hours.

name: Polyjuice Potion
d: Takes a month to brew and needs a bit of the person you want to turn into. Hermione's batch went wrong and turned her into a cat.

name: Regeneration Potion
d: Brewed in a giant cauldron in a graveyard, finished with bone of the father, flesh of the servant and blood of the enemy.

name: Shrinking Solution
d: Neville's turned orange when it should have been green. Snape tested it on Trevor, who turned into a tadpole.

name: Skele-Gro
d: Madam Pomfrey gave this to Harry after Lockhart vanished the bones in his arm. It burns going down and works overnight.

name: Sleekeazy's Hair Potion
d: Tames frizzy, bushy curls. Hermione used it to look smooth and shiny for the Yule Ball.

name: Sleeping Draught
d: Hermione hid it in two chocolate cakes to knock out Crabbe and Goyle before the Polyjuice plan.

name: Strengthening Solution
d: Fifth-years brewed it with salamander blood. Snape 'accidentally' smashed Harry's sample and gave him a zero.

name: Swelling Solution
d: Harry threw a firework into Goyle's cauldron and this splashed over the class, blowing up noses and arms.

name: Veritaserum
d: Three drops of this clear potion force the drinker to answer every question honestly. Snape threatened to slip some into Harry's pumpkin juice.

name: Wit-Sharpening Potion
d: Fourth-years brewed it with ground scarab beetles and armadillo bile on the day Rita Skeeter's article about Hermione came out.

name: Wolfsbane Potion
d: Lets someone with lycanthropy keep their mind after transforming. Snape brewed it for the Defence teacher, who forgot to take it on the night of the full moon.

name: Essence of Dittany
d: Hermione poured this over Ron's splinched arm. It smokes, and new skin grows over the wound in seconds.
